items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Encode tildes consistently with pathToFileURL**

When the repository path contains a literal `~`, Node's `pathToFileURL` serializes it as `%7E`, while jq's `@uri` here leaves `~` unescaped; the URL-side normalization also preserves the existing `%7E`. The equality therefore never matches the already-open tab, causing the hook to open another pane on every map write instead of reloading it. Normalize both sides with equivalent URL encoding.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Resolve relative paths from the physical working directory**

When the hook runs from a checkout reached through a symlink and the tool reports a relative path such as `./.project-map/index.html`, `$PWD` retains the logical symlink path, while terminal-browser's Node `pathToFileURL` conversion resolves it against the physical `process.cwd()`. The resulting paths never compare equal, so every later map write opens another pane instead of reloading the existing tab; derive the absolute event path using the same physical-directory semantics as terminal-browser.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Align trailing-slash matching with the reload guard**

When a listed tab URL ends in `/.project-map/index.html/`, `realpath` removes the trailing slash, so this comparison selects it as matching the event (the new test explicitly covers “tab trailing slash”). The eval on line 66 then checks `location.pathname.endsWith("/.project-map/index.html")`, which is false for that URL, so later writes issue the agent commands but never reload the tab. Either reject this URL form during matching or make the navigation guard accept the same canonical forms.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->
items.disposition: fixed:40d18027d5953c31ff57bcd7bbc250c6bb357bbc

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject encoded separators in file URLs**

When the listing contains a URL such as `file:///repo%2F.project-map/index.html` for the event path `/repo/.project-map/index.html`, `unquote()` turns the encoded slash into a path separator and incorrectly treats the two as the same file. Browsers preserve encoded separators in the URL, and standard file-URL-to-path conversion rejects them, so the hook pins and reloads a distinct or failed tab instead of opening the actual map; reject encoded `/` separators before decoding the URL path.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->
